name: Consultant

sections.daily_work: Analyze client problems and recommend solutions. Conduct research and interviews. Build models and frameworks. Present findings to stakeholders. Manage project timelines.
sections.learning: Analytical thinking, structured problem-solving (MECE, issue trees), data analysis, presentation skills, business strategy, financial modeling, stakeholder management.
sections.pay: Entry-level at major firms typically starts around $70,000-$90,000 USD. Mid-level $100,000-$150,000. Partners can earn $300,000+. Independent consultants vary widely. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Business or analytical degree, case interview preparation, internships at consulting firms, networking, specialized industry expertise, MBA for senior roles.

try_in_real_life: Practice case interviews (try free cases on McKinsey or BCG websites)
Analyze a local business problem and write a 1-page recommendation
Read 'Case in Point' or watch consulting case interview videos
Research management consulting firms and their recruiting timelines
sources: Management Consulted salary reports; Vault consulting industry guides
